alerts.title: 00:15:8d:00:02:56:f8:bf needs a power cycle
alerts.message: 00:15:8d:00:02:56:f8:bf is reporting readings it cannot physically produce: EP1 rms voltage 1012 V is above 300 V (mains voltage). They are kept out of its state and history. Power-cycle the device; this clears when it reports sensibly again.
